title: The Basket Over the Swallowing Sand
story: In the Glass Dunes, a whirling mouth of sand called Hollowmarch has opened beneath a caravan rest-stop, and 47 traders are stranded on a sinking stone platform. Mr 6 rigs a rope-and-pulley basket from the nearest cliff, tightens his little helmet, and starts counting instead of panicking. The basket holds only 6 travelers, and each round trip — down, load, and back up — takes exactly 4.5 minutes.
question: If Mr 6 must lift all 47 travelers to the cliff, how many minutes will the whole rescue take?
solution: 47 travelers ÷ 6 per basket = 7.83..., and you cannot send a partial basket, so Mr 6 needs 8 trips (7 full baskets of 6, plus 5 people in the last one).
praise: Dividing 47 by 6 was exactly the right opening move — the missing step was rounding that leftover group UP to one more whole basket before multiplying by the trip time.
hint: First ask: how many basketfuls does it take to move 47 people, 6 at a time — and what happens to the leftovers?
victory: The last basket swung up just as the platform slurped under, and Hollowmarch spat out nothing but a mouthful of empty crates. 'Arithmetic,' said Mr 6, coiling his rope, 'is faster than sand.'
imagePrompt: A brave numeral-six knight with a blue cape working a cliffside rope-pulley basket above a swirling funnel of golden quicksand, stranded traders waving from a tilting stone platform under a hot copper sky.
